<?php

class AuthTokenValidator {
    private $sharedSecret;
    private $logFile;
    
    public function __construct(string $secret, string $logPath) {
        $this->sharedSecret = $secret;
        $this->logFile = $logPath;
    }
    
    public function validateServiceToken(string $token, string $serviceId): bool {
        $expected = hash_hmac('sha256', $serviceId . ':' . time(), $this->sharedSecret);
        // Allow 30-second window for clock skew
        for ($i = -30; $i <= 30; $i++) {
            $candidate = hash_hmac('sha256', $serviceId . ':' . (time() + $i), $this->sharedSecret);
            if (hash_equals($candidate, $token)) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    public function logAuthAttempt(string $serviceId, bool $success, string $context): void {
        $timestamp = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
        $status = $success ? 'SUCCESS' : 'FAILURE';
        $entry = "[{$timestamp}] AUTH {$status} service={$serviceId} context={$context}";
        file_put_contents($this->logFile, $entry . PHP_EOL, FILE_APPEND | LOCK_EX);
    }
}

class EmailRateLimiter {
    private $store = [];
    private $maxPerMinute;
    
    public function __construct(int $maxPerMinute = 10) {
        $this->maxPerMinute = $maxPerMinute;
    }
    
    public function isAllowed(string $identifier): bool {
        $now = time();
        if (!isset($this->store[$identifier])) {
            $this->store[$identifier] = [];
        }
        $this->store[$identifier] = array_filter(
            $this->store[$identifier],
            fn($ts) => ($now - $ts) < 60
        );
        if (count($this->store[$identifier]) >= $this->maxPerMinute) {
            return false;
        }
        $this->store[$identifier][] = $now;
        return true;
    }
}

class EmailService {
    private AuthTokenValidator $auth;
    private EmailRateLimiter $limiter;
    private string $auditLog;
    
    public function __construct(AuthTokenValidator $auth, EmailRateLimiter $limiter, string $auditLog) {
        $this->auth = $auth;
        $this->limiter = $limiter;
        $this->auditLog = $auditLog;
    }
    
    public function handleRequest(array $request): array {
        $serviceId = $request['service_id'] ?? '';
        $token = $request['auth_token'] ?? '';
        $recipient = $request['to'] ?? '';
        $subject = $request['subject'] ?? '';
        $body = $request['body'] ?? '';
        
        // Validate authentication
        $authResult = $this->auth->validateServiceToken($token, $serviceId);
        
        // Build context string for audit logging
        $context = $this->buildAuditContext($recipient, $subject);
        
        // Log the authentication attempt with context
        $this->auth->logAuthAttempt($serviceId, $authResult, $context);
        
        if (!$authResult) {
            return ['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'Authentication failed'];
        }
        
        if (!$this->limiter->isAllowed($serviceId)) {
            $this->writeAudit($serviceId, 'RATE_LIMITED', $recipient);
            return ['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'Rate limit exceeded'];
        }
        
        if (!$this->validateRecipient($recipient)) {
            $this->writeAudit($serviceId, 'INVALID_RECIPIENT', $recipient);
            return ['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'Invalid recipient'];
        }
        
        // Send email
        $sent = $this->dispatchEmail($recipient, $subject, $body);
        $this->writeAudit($serviceId, $sent ? 'SENT' : 'SEND_FAILED', $recipient);
        
        return ['status' => $sent ? 'success' : 'error'];
    }
    
    private function buildAuditContext(string $recipient, string $subject): string {
        // Encode subject for safe logging - handles multi-byte properly
        $safeSubject = mb_substr($subject, 0, 50, 'UTF-8');
        $safeSubject = str_replace(['\\', '"', "\n", "\r", "\t"], ['\\\\', '\\"', ' ', ' ', ' '], $safeSubject);
        $safeRecipient = str_replace(["\n", "\r", "\t"], ['', '', ''], $recipient);
        return "to=" . $safeRecipient . " subject=\"" . $safeSubject . "\"";
    }
    
    private function validateRecipient(string $email): bool {
        return filter_var($email, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL) !== false;
    }
    
    private function dispatchEmail(string $to, string $subject, string $body): bool {
        // Strip CRLF (and other control chars) from headers-bound fields to prevent
        // email header injection (CWE-93). Subject is placed into a header by mail().
        $safeSubject = str_replace(["\r", "\n", "\0"], '', $subject);
        $safeTo = str_replace(["\r", "\n", "\0"], '', $to);
        // Reject if the sanitized recipient no longer validates as an email.
        if (filter_var($safeTo, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL) === false) {
            return false;
        }
        $headers = "From: noreply@service.internal\r\n";
        $headers .= "X-Mailer: InternalEmailService/2.1\r\n";
        $headers .= "Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8\r\n";
        return mail($safeTo, $safeSubject, $body, $headers);
    }
    
    private function writeAudit(string $serviceId, string $action, string $recipient): void {
        $timestamp = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
        $sanitizedRecipient = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9@._\-]/', '', $recipient);
        $entry = "[{$timestamp}] EMAIL {$action} service={$serviceId} recipient={$sanitizedRecipient}";
        file_put_contents($this->auditLog, $entry . PHP_EOL, FILE_APPEND | LOCK_EX);
    }
}
